title: SEC4: assign_devid functions lack doc comments
description: wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() and wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid_ssl() in crypto2dev_port.c have no function-level comments. Both functions have a non-obvious side effect: they set the global g_tls_safe_mode flag, which silently redirects all HASH operations to software for the lifetime of the process. The header (crypto2dev_port.h line 46-49) has a one-line inline note but it is too brief to convey the g_tls_safe_mode lifetime and process-global scope. Add a comment block above each function explaining: (1) what it registers, (2) that it sets g_tls_safe_mode globally, (3) that this affects all subsequent HASH callbacks regardless of devId.
